name: motif_add_phonological_rule
description:
Author a phonological rule. Research first: motif_guide topic nasal-assimilation or phonological-rules or feature-rules; check best practice. Use only if the project parses with HermitCrab and a regular sound change holds across many morphemes in a context you can state; otherwise use an alternate form for one irregular word. Limit it by category with inputCategories (guide phonological-rules). Stages one regular phonological rule in a Draft, with one or more ordered right-hand sides, each with its own Output, contexts and rule features, and up to eight items in each Input and Output sequence. Output classes allow lexical alternatives; overlapping right-hand sides use the first applicable case, while feature changes preserve other features and alpha variables express agreement or disagreement. Only a person can Apply.
Command: compose-author-phonological-rule. Agent class: Draft.
DraftName: The name of the Draft being authored.
IntentJson: The closed semantic intent JSON accepted by this composer.
